title: the postfix `catch` recovery expression is retired: recover with Result.match() or recover()
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Inference', names the postfix Result-recovery expression among the grammars Smithers MUST NOT add. Statement-form `try { } catch { }` stays legal — the scanner distinguishes the retired postfix form by the absence of a preceding '}' token — and 09-foreign-calls/try-catch-does-not-change-the-result-contract pins that.
